dct_title_s: Satellite detected water extent in Ag Geneina and Kereneik, West Darfur State, Sudan as of 5 September 2024s of 5 September 2024
dct_description_sm: **UNOSAT code: FL20240826SDN, GDACS ID: 1102854** This map illustrates satellite-detected water extents in the two towns of Ag Geneina and Kereneik, West Darfur State, Sudan as observed from a Sentinel-2 image acquired on 5 September 2024 at 11:06 local time (09:06 UTC). Within the analysed area of about 700 km², a total of about 50 km² of land appears to be affected by floodwaters. This is a preliminary analysis and has not yet been validated in the field. Please send ground feedback to the United Nations Satellite Centre (UNOSAT).
